posts.title_en: F2P players, just use this deck
posts.summary_en: The reference 'Rye one-carry' (호밀 원툴) deck that the gallery's 정보 tab links and everyone later calls 정보탭 호밀덱. Preset named 아레나/토벌, 13.87M power. Poster says it defends very well; perks 피감 (Armor Repair) + 열정페이. The defense-log screenshot is from Rumble Arena (S-server tags, +125 medals).

teams.name: Rye deck, Brightseeker + Donut + Crepe version (lost)

Rockstar is a real wall.

posts.title_en: Rockstar instead of Grapevine seems fine in Arena
posts.summary_en: Tests the Rye deck with Rockstar in the Grapevine slot. Rockstar's recent skill-ready (스킬준비) buff makes its shield land during Bari's first dive. Screenshots: Rumble attack at 13.27M vs 16.72M Bari–Oven, and three regular Arena (시즌5 아레나) fights, including a win at 13.27M against the server's #2 (20.4M) running Brightseeker/Oven/Bari/Cherry Cola, where Rye did 2.21M damage. Long thread on why Regular Arena Bari burst is harder to survive than Rumble.

teams.name: Rye one-carry, Donut + Rockstar version

cookies.note: 649K damage in the Arena win; polymorph keeps Rye alive
replaces Grapevine; runes: whatever of HP/Skill AMP/Skill Haste/DR rolls, poster reached 8 skill haste from runes
Rye in line with Hound receives Macaron's buff
preferred over Crepe now: skill-ready buff, and Bari's push immunity blunts Crepe

cookies.en: Moon Rabbit Cookie's Pampered with Persimmon

pets: 전지멜로우 ★15 (later swapped to a DR pet)

teams.formation: top: Macaron, Donut, Cheesecake, Rockstar, Hound, Herb / bottom: Rye, Pinot Noir, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Moon Rabbit (13.27M)
teams.why: Grapevine's heal comes too late against Bari–Oven; Rockstar's shield comes during Bari's first attack. Skating Queen tried: fast after its buff but dies wandering. Crepe tried: Bari grants push immunity, so Crepe's knockback matters less.
unorthodox: Rockstar (SR) in a top Arena team

counters.beaten_by: Bari–Oven deck at similar or higher power

mechanics: Rumble Arena gives +30% DR (피감30%); regular Arena does not, so Bari burst is deadlier in regular Arena.
Macaron's buff reaches Rye when Rye is in line with Hound (Range synergy sets Macaron's march line).
Brightseeker's drones vanish when their target dies, and her beam is single-target, so she is judged worse than piercing Rye for Arena.

results.note: beat 20.4M server #2 Bari–Oven in regular Arena; beat 8★ Seeker twice

disagreements: One commenter: in regular Arena at similar power the Rye deck still dies in one hit to Bari–Oven. Another: after swapping Grapevine for Rockstar it no longer dies to Bari.

quotes.kr: 락스타도 이번에 스킬준비 버프 받은게 바리공주 첫방 버티게 해주는데 꽤 큰 의미가 있는듯

quotes.kr: 와레나는 피감30%가 달려있고 서버아레나는 없어서 차이가 좀 있긴 함
quotes.en: Rumble has 30% DR attached and server Arena doesn't, so there is a difference.

Grapevine often fails to heal before cookies die at the start; Rockstar with 3-4 skill-haste lines holds through Bari's timing. Formation at 8.74M. Defense-log screenshots are Rumble. Commenters argue about Skating Queen and whether Seeker is worth it.

posts.title_en: Is Seeker + Donut stronger than Grapevine + Skating in the Rye deck?
posts.summary_en: Formation of the Seeker/Donut Rye version at 16.56M. Replies: surprisingly the Grapevine version is stronger, because against Bari or Rye decks the front-line Herb often dies first and Grapevine is backup healing. Seeker makes the deck weaker; only Skating↔Donut and Grapevine↔Rockstar are worth swapping.

cookies.en: Moon Rabbit Cookie's Pampered with Persimmon

mechanics: Against Bari and Rye decks the Herb in the line that gets hit first tends to die first, so a second healer (Grapevine) matters.
disagreements: Seeker/Donut vs Grapevine/Skating: one user prefers Seeker/Donut (75773); others say Grapevine/Skating is stronger and Seeker weakens the deck.

quotes.en: Strangely, the Grapevine version is stronger.

quotes.kr: 시커 이새기 들어가면 오히려 약해짐 피겨<->도넛 포도<->락스타 정도만 바꿀만 한듯
quotes.en: Adding Seeker actually makes it weaker; only Skating↔Donut and Grapevine↔Rockstar are worth swapping.

disagreements: Seeker+Donut favoured here, against 76349 and 76751.

quotes.en: If Seeker isn't 5★, the Skating/Grapevine version is probably better.

posts.title_en: How do I beat my server's Arena #1?
posts.summary_en: Pre-Bari meta. Server #1 (14.58M, 3,911 trophies) runs Wind Archer, Macaron, Milky Way, Brightseeker, Rye, Donut, Pinot Noir, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Milk, Hound, Herb with pets Chargemellow, Holy Baby Drop, King Choco Drop. Poster's 16.6M deck (Macaron, Rye, Pinot, Pomegranate, Hound, Crepe, Seeker, Donut, Cheesecake, Milk, Ion Lv94, Herb) keeps losing. Advice: gear crit rate over crit damage because opponents run crit RES; drop Seeker/Herb for Bari and Espresso (5 ranged); swap the Rapid Fire pet for a DR pet.

teams.name: Server #1 five-ranged deck (pre-Bari)
teams.formation: defense-log order, not the formation grid; 14.58M
teams.why: Five ranged dealers for 탄약비 전액 지원 (+15 skill haste for 5+ ranged).

builds.sugar_runes: Ion: HP, crit RES, DR, Skill Haste. Macaron: Skill AMP + Skill Haste. Rye: ATK + Skill AMP.
builds.gear: 6 Skill Haste lines; weapons Skill AMP + crit RATE (not crit DMG); crit RES and DR low row; drop RES
builds.why: Opponents stack crit RES, so crit DMG is wasted when crits don't land.

mechanics: Donut King's polymorph can land on several cookies at once if the attacker has some Focus (~800); one line of RES was not enough to stop it.

quotes.kr: 상대도 치저피감 보통낄텐데 치명이안터지면 치피가 뭔 의미가있노
quotes.en: Opponents usually run crit RES and DR; if crits don't land, what's crit DMG for?

The key difference spotted: the opponent's Milk captain is merc level 4, unlocking Armor Repair (DR 10%) and Passion Pay. Advice: Rye + Rockstar in theory; if still marginal, swap Choco Drop for Icy Birdie.

posts.title_en: The Bari deck isn't strong just because of 30% HP
posts.summary_en: Cherry Cola, Oven and Bari dive together and delete an equal-power team in about 3.5 seconds, around 2M damage each. One side says a defensive deck that survives one tick wins; another says Ion and Rockstar shields after their skill-ready buff sometimes stop the instant kill, making it a luck contest of Ion/Rockstar/Donut procs. One user says at similar spec the Rye one-carry deck crushes it.

counters.beaten_by: decks whose Ion/Rockstar shields land before the dive
counters.why: If the three-charger dive doesn't kill instantly, the Bari deck loses the long fight.

mechanics: The Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola dive does about 2M per cookie within about 3.5s at equal power.
disagreements: Whether a defensive deck can survive the dive: '100-200th rank' user says yes, others say the damage is too high.

quotes.kr: 체콜이랑 오방 바리 3명 뛰어들면 동투력인데 한큐에 다 터짐
quotes.en: When Cherry Cola, Oven and Bari jump in, an equal-power team pops in one go.

quotes.kr: 이온 락스타 + 도넛 스킬 확률 운빨 싸움임
quotes.en: It's a luck fight over Ion, Rockstar and Donut skill timing.

disagreements: 'It's just setting differences' vs 'nobody at similar power broke through'.

quotes.kr: 결국 세팅 차이인데 호밀 바리 차이 말하는건 의미가 없음
quotes.en: It's settings; arguing Rye vs Bari is meaningless.

posts.title_en: Bari decks get shredded by same-power Rye decks
posts.summary_en: Poster wiped all the 5★ Bari decks on his server with Rye. One reply says they have never lost to the same weight class after switching to Bari. Another notes regular Arena has no charger buff (Rumble does).
disagreements: Rye beats same-power 5★ Bari vs 'never lost to same power with Bari'.

posts.title_en: My server's Arena finally dropped Oven–Bari
posts.summary_en: Except #1, the top of the poster's server went back to the Rye deck. Replies: Bari–Oven needs very high spec, is bad for mid spenders; even Bari 7★ + Oven 9★ players use Rye; in Arena it's the #1's tool for farming weaker players or locking in the top.

results.usage: most of the top of one server except #1

quotes.kr: 바리오방덱은 스팩이 엄청 좋아야 좋은 덱이라 어정쩡한 중소과금은 ㄹㅇ 별로임
quotes.en: Bari–Oven is only good with a huge spec; bad for mid spenders.
Even Bari 7★ / Oven 9★ ends up on the Rye deck.

posts.title_en: Bari–Oven in regular Arena, not just Rumble?
posts.summary_en: Poster (Bari 7★, Oven 8★) finds Bari–Oven underwhelming at the top. Replies: one player in a #1 fight uses Rye in Rumble and Bari–Oven in regular Arena and says his rival's Rye can't hold once he hit Bari 10★; from Bari 5★ up regular Arena favours Bari; 'it's gear difference'; good for grinding weaker teams quickly.
mechanics: Several users run different decks per mode: Rye in Rumble (where +30% DR helps it survive), Bari–Oven in regular Arena.
disagreements: Bari 7★/Oven 8★ is 'meh' at the top vs 'from 5★ Bari it's the performance pick in regular Arena'.

Once he got Bari to 10★, I couldn't hold with the Rye deck at all.

posts.title_en: How do I break the Bari deck?
posts.summary_en: Poster wins under half against Bari with Rye. Replies: nothing in the Rye deck beats a 10★ Bari deck; the answer is not to attack it.

quotes.en: Nothing works against a 10★ Bari deck with Rye.

posts.title_en: If Rye loses at equal power, is something wrong?
posts.summary_en: Poster runs the 74483 deck at 19-20M and gets sliced by Bari at equal power before heals and shields go off. builds.why: Heals and shields must come out before the dive.

mechanics: Whoever loses their Milk or their Bari first loses the fight.

quotes.kr: 우유랑 바리 중에 먼저 뒤지는 쪽이 짐
quotes.en: Whichever of Milk or Bari dies first, that side loses.

counters.beaten_by: Rye one-carry deck with merc perks set, or a much stronger Bari–Oven
counters.why: Mirror is decided by perks; Bari needs enough burst to kill before sustain.

quotes.kr: 같은 호밀덱 가자 상대 복지 세팅 안했으면 이김

The 익명의 도전자 card and +175 medals mark this as Rumble Arena.

posts.title_en: Arena copies trends fast
posts.summary_en: After the poster hit people with the Rye one-carry deck, they copied it within a meal. Reply lays out a rock-paper-scissors: counter Rye with Crepe + Espresso (Crepe counters Moon Rabbit's 떡방아 by knocking back, Espresso's black hole launches Rye from behind); if they copy Crepe–Espresso, counter with Bari. Another server's top ranks run Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola.

counters.beaten_by: Rye deck with Crepe + Espresso added (딸크에소)
counters.why: Crepe's knockback pushes Moon Rabbit away before its debuff; Espresso's black hole launches Rye.
Bari's aura gives chargers push/lift immunity, cancelling Crepe and Espresso's displacement.

mechanics: Knockback/launch interrupts: Crepe pushes, Espresso's black hole launches; Bari's aura gives push and lift immunity to charge-type allies.

quotes.kr: 딸크가 떡방아 카운터치고 에소가 뒤에서 호밀 날려버림
quotes.en: Crepe counters the rice-cake pound and Espresso launches Rye from behind.

quotes.kr: 서버 애들이 딸크에소마저 따라하면 바리덱으로 카운터쳐서 조져라
quotes.en: If they copy Crepe–Espresso too, counter with the Bari deck.

quotes.en: At a glance: Milk, Pomegranate, Macaron, Crepe, Espresso, Moon Rabbit, Ion, Donut, Herb, Hound; not sure about the last two.

posts.title_en: Bari deck is trending; any counter?
posts.summary_en: Answers: Rye one-carry deck. One suggests a Rapid Fire deck with Donut King and Adventurer so Oven can't do anything. One says Bari decks are oddly weak to 3-tank Rye.

counters.beaten_by: Rapid Fire deck with Donut King + Adventurer (theory)

quotes.en: Strangely weak to the 3-tank Rye deck.

posts.title_en: The info-tab Rye deck is weak to Bari + Cherry Cola
posts.summary_en: The info-tab Rye deck can't beat Bari + Cherry Cola. Replies: Grapevine instead of Seeker is stronger; in regular Arena few use Bari so it's fine.

posts.title_en: What counters the Arena Rye deck?
posts.summary_en: Poster loses to Rye even with Bari and Moon Rabbit. Answers: a stronger Rye; a deck with Cherry Cola, Bari and Oven wins when it deletes Rye in one go.

counters.why: Rye dies in one burst; the deck has no other damage.
counters.conditions: burst must kill Rye at once

quotes.kr: 체리바리 오방까지 넣은덱 쓸때 호밀 한번에 날아가면 지더라
quotes.en: Against a Cherry Cola–Bari–Oven deck, it loses when Rye goes down in one hit.

posts.title_en: Fought it again
posts.summary_en: Poster's 17-18M Rye one-carry deck lost 3 of 3 to the chain/skeleton deck of 75982 despite 1,100 accuracy. Analysis in comments: Rye's first skill jumps toward the lone Schwarzwälder top-left and wastes itself there; the opponent's many sub-dealers (Schwarzwälder, Dr. Bones) take Rye's supports apart; a textbook counter.

counters.beaten_by: Chain deck with Vampire, Twizzly, Dr. Bones, Schwarzwälder (75982)
counters.why: Schwarzwälder soaks Rye's first skill; many sub-dealers kill Rye's supports; Rye is the only damage.

mechanics: Rye's skill fires at the enemy it faces; an isolated decoy (here Schwarzwälder) can absorb its first volley.
A one-carry deck is fragile to teams with spread damage.
disagreements: Whether RES would help; whether accuracy was the problem (poster had 1,100).

quotes.en: Schwarzwälder absorbs all of Rye's skill by himself and dies.

quotes.kr: 그냥 딜이 호밀 원툴인데 쟤넨 서브딜이 많아서 파츠 먼저 분해당하고 지는 것 같음
quotes.en: Your damage is Rye alone; they have lots of sub-damage, so your parts get dismantled first.

posts.title_en: Who invented this deck?
posts.summary_en: Photo of the 17.59M defense deck that beat the poster: a Chain (연쇄) deck with Vampire, Twizzly Gummy, Dr. Bones, Schwarzwälder, Skating Queen (grants Chain synergy) and an evasion pet. Battle stats (75966): Vampire 1.78M, Pinot 979K, Twizzly 832K, Hound 620K, Ion 498K.

teams.name: Chain / 'skeleton' deck (연쇄덱, 해골덱)

cookies.note: decoy that eats Rye's first skill

cookies.role: main DPS; bat form hits highest-ATK enemy and lowers its accuracy

pets: 치즈뭉치 고양이 (Fluffy Cheese Cat, Chain pet) ★20
teams.formation: as photographed on the 상대 방어팀 card; 17.59M
teams.why: Chain synergy (Pinot, Vampire, Dr. Bones, Twizzly, Skating Queen) plus the Chain pet; several sub-dealers spread damage.
unorthodox: Schwarzwälder and Dr. Bones in Arena

disagreements: Commenters guess it is an evasion deck; others say Vampire just worked well.

quotes.en: Got destroyed even with 1,100 accuracy.

posts.title_kr: 회피덱으로 첫 그마2 등반 후 마무리
posts.title_en: Reached Grand Master 2 with an evasion deck
posts.summary_en: Season 4 Arena: an 11.13M evasion deck (preset 아레나 회피) climbed from Elite Master 1 to Grand Master 2, finishing 9th overall; poster ~120th in total power, Bari and Seeker only 5★. Pets: Mango Toucan Lv20 (raw evasion under 1000 so Cheese Drop went back in on another build), Holy Baby Drop, Chargemellow (Crepe and Rye are Rapid Fire). Gear low row evasion+crit RES and evasion+skill haste; upper left Skill AMP, upper right Focus + Skill Haste. Loses to stage-gear decks with accuracy; works while the server doesn't know it.

teams.name: Evasion deck (회피덱)
teams.formation: top: Macaron, Donut, Cheesecake, Vampire, Milk, Ion / bottom: Rye, Pinot Noir, Pomegranate, Lime, Hound, Crepe (11.13M)
teams.why: Opponents on arena gear have little accuracy, so evasion near 1000 makes them miss; Vampire lowers the top attacker's accuracy further.
unorthodox: evasion gear instead of crit RES/DR

builds.gear: upper left Skill AMP (+crit); upper right Focus + Skill Haste; lower row Evasion + crit RES and Evasion + Skill Haste; 6 Skill Haste lines required; plates left side +15, right side +12-13
builds.why: Evasion ~1000 target; Focus for Vampire's accuracy-down and Donut's polymorph.

mechanics: Raw evasion around 1000 needed; watch at 0.5x to see MISS.
rules: Grand Master 2 first promotion pays 6,000 diamonds; GM2 condition: 3,000 trophies and top 5 overall.

quotes.en: It is a gimmick that loses to stage decks, true.
Six evasion/skill-haste pieces seem mandatory.

posts.title_en: Touched Grand Master with an evasion deck
posts.summary_en: Same player, earlier: 9.69M evasion deck, same lineup as 72977 (Pinot Noir, Pomegranate, Lime, Hound, Crepe in the bottom row). Pets Mango Toucan 20, Holy Baby Drop 20, Hot Doggie 18. Picked targets under 10M, sometimes beats 11M, but loses to 7M decks with accuracy. Evasion runes only on Ion, Hound, Vampire (2-3 lines); gear evasion+crit RES and evasion+skill haste; upper right Focus + Skill Haste. Evasion ~1000 without max plates.

counters.beaten_by: any deck with some accuracy gear

builds.why: Focus on the upper right gear for Vampire's accuracy-down and Donut.

mechanics: Evasion decks can beat higher-power opponents, which normal arena decks rarely do.

quotes.kr: 랭커 아레나 덱은 투력 이하는 확실히 잡아도 그 이상은 못잡는 느낌인데 회피덱은 그 이상을 잡을 때가 있다
quotes.en: Ranker decks reliably beat lower power but not higher; the evasion deck sometimes beats higher.

posts.title_en: Review: evasion (회슝좍) deck with Peach
posts.summary_en: 16.51M evasion deck built around Bari with Peach and Vampire, evasion ~900 in dungeon. Beat a 21.43M team (Rumble screen): Bari 3.54M, Cherry Cola 758K, Peach 312K. Against unprepared decks the power gap is meaningless; against stage-gear high-power defense or accuracy-built decks it struggles. Peach doesn't always go forward; if Vampire dies early it collapses.

teams.name: Bari evasion deck (회슝좍) with Peach

cookies.role: charge, gains evasion rate after dash (aggro sponge)

cookies.en: Moon Rabbit Cookie's Pampered with Persimmon

teams.formation: top: Macaron, Pinot Noir, Vampire, Bari, Milk, Cherry Cola / bottom: Donut, Pomegranate, Skating Queen, Peach, Ion, Moon Rabbit (16.51M)
teams.why: Bari's aura on Cherry Cola and Peach plus evasion stats; Eggbeak adds charge DR.

quotes.kr: 상대가 회슝좍에 대비가 안된 덱이면 투력차이가 무의미한 수준
quotes.en: If the opponent isn't prepared for evasion, power gaps stop mattering.

posts.title_en: Satan's own evasion deck
posts.summary_en: Battle stats of a Bari 10★ evasion deck: Bari 1.60M, Cherry Cola 728K, Brightseeker 679K, Vampire 193K, Moon Rabbit, Donut, Pinot, Skating Queen; and Cherry Cola 1.93M / Bari 1.43M in another. All day of MISS.

posts.title_en: Budget evasion deck defends quite well
posts.summary_en: 6.8M budget evasion defense on a small server, with a 10M defense success. Lineup: Macaron, Donut, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Rye, Pinot Noir, Vampire, Hound, Crepe, Moon Rabbit (the image shows Moon Rabbit). Pets Hot Doggie, Icy Birdie, Cheese Drop. Wishlist with 5★ Bari: Macaron, Bari, Vampire, Cherry Cola, Peach, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Pinot, Crepe, Moon Rabbit.

posts.title_en: If the opponent runs evasion + DR
posts.summary_en: If defenders run evasion, attackers can switch to stage gear (with accuracy). It becomes rock-paper-scissors, but you can't see the opponent's gear before attacking. In Rumble names are hidden, so you can't remember who runs evasion.

counters.conditions: must know the defender is evasion; names visible in regular Arena, hidden in Rumble

mechanics: Opponent gear isn't visible before a fight; in regular Arena names are visible so you can remember evasion defenders.

posts.title_en: Moon Rabbit 10★ + Bari 3★: perfect win over rank #1
posts.summary_en: Launch-day report: server #1 (all cookies 10★) beaten flawlessly. Moon Rabbit 10★ (runes Focus, Skill Haste, HP, DR at SR+) hit the enemy Milk with its ATK-down and crit-rate-down, crippling Milk's buff and Seeker's drones; 10★ Cherry Cola and Bari tore the 10★ Milk apart. Gear: the usual Skill Haste/Skill AMP/evasion arena set. Pets Eggbeak, a tank-evasion pet (+18%: Breadog), Holy Baby Drop. Passion Pay had lowered the enemy Milk's HP.

teams.name: Moon Rabbit 10★ + Bari + Cherry Cola

cookies.en: Moon Rabbit Cookie's Pampered with Persimmon
cookies.note: runes Focus, Skill Haste, HP, DR

pets: 식빵아지 (Breadog, tank evasion rate; poster says 18%)
teams.why: Moon Rabbit's debuff lands on the enemy Milk and ruins its ATK buff; Bari-wrapped chargers dive the Milk.

counters.why: Moon Rabbit ATK/crit-down on Milk; dive kills Milk; Passion Pay had cut Milk's HP by 20%.
counters.conditions: single fight on launch day; a reply says play 30 games before concluding

builds.sugar_runes: Focus, Skill Haste, HP, DR (SR or better)
builds.why: Land the debuff (Focus) quickly (Skill Haste) and survive.

mechanics: Passion Pay (+20% ATK, -20% max HP on highest-ATK ally) usually lands on Milk, making Milk the soft target.

quotes.kr: 달토끼가 우유 공깍하면 우유 버프 개떡락하겠구나 달토끼 진짜 필수네
quotes.en: If Moon Rabbit cuts Milk's ATK, Milk's buff tanks; Moon Rabbit really is essential.

posts.title_en: Moon Rabbit and Princess Bari skill coefficients (datamine)
posts.summary_en: Datamined (rough) values: Bari 9★ grants 40% DR; Moon Rabbit 9★ ATK -50%, crit reduction 130%, radius ~4.2. The poster says it's a quick read. Commenters conclude crit damage stats are now nearly worthless and Arena will be ruled by 9★ Bari.
mechanics: Bari 9★ aura: 40% DR to self and charge-type allies (datamine, unverified).
Moon Rabbit 9★: ATK -50%, crit -130%, radius ~4.2 (datamine, unverified).

quotes.kr: 바리공주 9성 : 피감 40% 달토끼 9성 : 공감 50% 치명감소 130% 범위 4.2?
quotes.en: Bari 9★: DR 40%. Moon Rabbit 9★: ATK -50%, crit -130%, radius 4.2?

posts.title_kr: 바리공주는 계수 까봐야 안다고 하는 이유가
posts.title_en: Why Bari's value depends on her coefficients
posts.summary_en: Pre-release analysis: Bari's aura also deals periodic damage around each wrapped charger; a leak says it scales on the buffed cookie's ATK, not Bari's. Her dash is slow and wrecks formations.
mechanics: Bari's aura deals periodic area damage around every charge-type ally it wraps; per leak the damage uses the wrapped cookie's ATK. 76065 repeats this.
disagreements: Whether the aura damage uses Bari's ATK or the wrapped cookie's ATK.

posts.title_en: What sugar runes for Bari?
posts.summary_en: Advice: Skill Haste + DR; about 45 skill haste keeps the aura up permanently. Skill AMP doesn't raise the DR buff but may raise aura damage; alternatively ATK so Bari catches Pomegranate's beam.

builds.sugar_runes: Skill Haste + DR; ~45 Skill Haste for permanent aura uptime (alt: ATK to catch Pomegranate)
builds.why: Aura uptime; Skill AMP doesn't scale the DR part.

disagreements: Skill AMP vs Skill Haste+DR vs ATK on Bari.

quotes.en: You need about 45 Skill Haste to keep it up permanently.

posts.title_en: Can't beat the Rye deck no matter what
posts.summary_en: Oven Wanderer rune sheet with HP-amp lines and two DR lines. Replies: all ATK% may be fine because Bari's aura damage scales on the buffed cookie's ATK; the Oven deck loses if it doesn't kill at the start, so give damage stats; stacking HP beyond 1-2 lines is worse than DR.

builds.sugar_runes: damage lines (ATK%/Skill AMP) rather than HP amp; 1-2 HP lines max, DR better beyond that
builds.why: Bari aura damage scales on Oven's ATK; the deck must kill in the opening.

quotes.kr: 올공증 나쁘지 않을수도. 바리버프가 대상자에 공격력비례라
quotes.en: All ATK% might be fine, since Bari's buff scales with the target's ATK.

posts.title_en: Moon Rabbit is worse in Arena than expected
posts.summary_en: Claim: Moon Rabbit only debuffs the front line, and outside Bari decks there are no dealers there. Replies: it's mandatory insurance, without it Oven kills in 2s; strong spenders punch through it anyway.
mechanics: Moon Rabbit's debuff hits enemies around it, i.e. the front line; per 75736 it rarely reaches Macaron's position.
disagreements: Moon Rabbit is bad (front-line only) vs mandatory insurance against Oven.

quotes.kr: 달토끼는 걍 필수 보험임 걔 없이 오방 만나면 2초컷 나옴
quotes.en: Moon Rabbit is mandatory insurance; without it Oven kills you in 2 seconds.

posts.title_en: Rockstar instead of Moon Rabbit?
posts.summary_en: 8★+ Bari punches through anyway; answer: run both Moon Rabbit and Rockstar.

quotes.en: Using both is the standard.

posts.title_en: With Cheesecake and Pinot Noir, is Herb dead weight?
posts.summary_en: Poster's 12.92M 'bullet-cut' deck (Macaron, Oven, Cheesecake, Bari, Hound, Cherry Cola, Brightseeker, Pinot, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Moon Rabbit; pets King Choco Drop 20, Hot Doggie 19, Holy Baby 19) asks about replacing Herb with a back-line ranged dealer. Replies: without Herb, Milk can't self-heal and dies alone; running Milk + Herb + Ion is what stops the one-shot.
mechanics: Milk can't heal itself; Herb is needed to keep Milk alive. Ion's shields ignore healing reduction.

quotes.kr: 우유 허브 이온 3개 돌리는게 한방에 안터지고 이기는데 허브빼면 터져뒤지드라
quotes.en: Running Milk, Herb and Ion together survives the burst and wins; without Herb it pops.

posts.title_en: Moon Rabbit in Hound's slot?
posts.summary_en: Hound gives Range synergy, which aligns Macaron's march; Milky Way ruins Macaron's alignment and must go. Standard tank trio: Hound, Ion, Moon Rabbit.
mechanics: Hound's Range synergy lines up Macaron's march; Milky Way monopolises/ruins Macaron's alignment (also 68046).
Standard tank trio: Hound, Ion, Moon Rabbit.

quotes.kr: 들개는 범위 시너지라 마카롱 정렬맞추는게 의미가있음
quotes.en: Hound gives Range synergy, which matters for lining up Macaron.

posts.title_en: Is Hound mandatory in Arena?
posts.summary_en: Poster loses without Hound. Reply: compare which direction Macaron's skill goes; without Hound it fires badly.
mechanics: Without Hound, Macaron's skill goes in a bad direction.

posts.title_kr: 딱히 없는 것 같아서 메모해놓는 스테/아레나/토벌 장비 옵션 (조언요)
posts.title_en: Gear substats for stage / Arena / Conquest
posts.summary_en: Gear guide (5 recommends). Arena: weapons Skill AMP + crit rate or crit DMG; armour DR+HP or DR+crit RES (DR+crit RES the norm); accessories Skill Haste + Skill AMP; specials Skill Haste + DR or crit RES. Top comment gives the Arena grid: upper-left Skill AMP+crit rate, upper-right Skill Haste+Skill AMP, lower-left crit RES+DR, lower-right Skill Haste+crit RES.

builds.gear: upper-left (weapons): Skill AMP + crit rate; upper-right (accessories): Skill Haste + Skill AMP; lower-left (armour): crit RES + DR; lower-right (special): Skill Haste + crit RES
builds.why: Skill Haste on all six right-side pieces; crit RES and DR because Arena damage crits.

disagreements: Armour DR+HP vs DR+crit RES.

quotes.kr: [아레나] 좌상단 : 스증치확 / 우상단 : 스가스증 / 좌하단 : 치저피감 / 우하단 : 스가치저
quotes.en: [Arena] upper-left Skill AMP + crit rate / upper-right Skill Haste + Skill AMP / lower-left crit RES + DR / lower-right Skill Haste + crit RES.

posts.title_en: Is Skill Haste mandatory in Arena?
posts.summary_en: Choosing between an Eternal necklace with crit RES 25.43% / Focus +111 / Skill Haste +3.40 and one with crit RES 26.06% / crit rate 9.38% / Skill AMP 5.62%. Consensus: never drop Skill Haste; the six right-side pieces are all Skill Haste. Dissent: Bari decks drop skill haste; make a separate preset.

builds.gear: All 6 right-side pieces carry Skill Haste
builds.why: Healing/shield cycles.

disagreements: Bari decks reportedly drop Skill Haste (dive decks care less about cycles).

quotes.en: Yes, the right six are Skill Haste, no exceptions.
With Bari you throw Skill Haste away.

posts.title_en: Crit rate vs crit DMG in Arena?
posts.summary_en: Weapon choice: +21.39% crit rate / +8% Skill AMP vs +9.01% Skill AMP / +16.23% crit DMG. Answers split: take higher Skill AMP; crit rate always in Arena. One user claims crit rate over 100% overflows into stronger crits (official, up to 300%?) and crit RES cancels crit rate, so crit rate is the pick.

builds.gear: Weapon: crit rate over crit DMG (majority); some prefer highest Skill AMP
builds.why: Crit RES reduces crit chance; crit DMG does nothing without crits.

mechanics: Claim (low confidence): crit rate above 100% becomes 'strong crits', said to be official; crit RES subtracts from crit rate.
disagreements: Crit rate vs Skill AMP priority.

quotes.en: Crit rate over 100% triggers strong crits.

posts.title_en: Crit rate+DMG vs crit DMG+Skill AMP
posts.summary_en: Nothing beats Skill AMP; crit rate+Skill AMP best; in Arena think about Moon Rabbit (crit rate reduction), so crit rate for Arena and crit DMG for Conquest.

builds.why: Moon Rabbit's crit reduction makes crit rate the constraint in Arena.

quotes.en: In Arena you have to account for Moon Rabbit.

posts.title_kr: 다들 아레나 프리셋에 치저 몇개 씀?
posts.title_en: How many crit RES pieces in your Arena preset?
posts.summary_en: Of the six lower-row pieces: one says all 6 crit RES since people still run crit decks and Moon Rabbit can't reach back lines; a known Rye player uses 4.

builds.gear: 4-6 crit RES pieces in the lower row
builds.why: Most damage still crits; Moon Rabbit's crit-down doesn't reach back lines.

disagreements: 4 vs 6 crit RES pieces.

posts.title_en: DR better than crit RES in Arena?
posts.summary_en: In-battle Milk stat panels: poster's Milk crit RES 83.55% / DR 24.68% / Skill AMP 140% / Skill Haste 22; opponent's Milk (whom he keeps losing to) crit RES 60.83% / DR 38.37% / Skill AMP 145.5% / Skill Haste 20.4 / crit DMG 84.7%. Reply: DR.

builds.gear: Observed in battle: crit RES 60.83%, DR 38.37%, Skill AMP 145.50%, Skill Haste 20.4, crit DMG 84.70% (winning side, 5.83M team)
builds.why: Past a point DR beats more crit RES.

posts.title_kr: 지금 아레나 장비에 치저 하나도 없는데
posts.title_en: No crit RES on my Arena gear
posts.summary_en: Poster's arena set: weapons Skill AMP/crit DMG, armour DR/HP, top accessories Skill Haste/Skill AMP, lower accessories Skill Haste/DR. Replies: for Arena crit RES beats HP; one runs crit RES on everything except one DR piece. Commenters call the poster's set a Conquest set.
mechanics: Crit RES is useless in Conquest but valuable in Arena; this is the main reason to keep separate Arena and Conquest presets.

posts.title_en: Arena is fine without accuracy
posts.summary_en: Poster removed the one accuracy line and barely sees MISS; enemy evasion is around 650.

builds.why: Typical enemy evasion ~650.

mechanics: Typical Arena evasion is about 650 unless the defender runs an evasion build (~900-1000).
disagreements: Evasion-deck posts (69591, 72977) show accuracy matters against them.

posts.title_en: Skill AMP matters on Arena gear
posts.summary_en: Poster won 10 of 10 against someone, dropped two Skill AMP lines for power, and immediately lost. Reply: Skill AMP is the top stat in this game because it also scales buffs.

builds.why: Skill AMP scales buffs as well as damage.

mechanics: Skill AMP increases buff amounts too (per commenter).

results.win_rate: 10/10 before, loss after removing 2 Skill AMP lines

posts.title_en: The Arena preset clears stages better
posts.summary_en: At stage 290 the arena preset (1G 900M, Skill AMP/Skill Haste) clears better than the stage preset (2G 100M, accuracy/focus). Many agree 6 Skill Haste beats accuracy/focus at the 35% power cut.
mechanics: Arena presets show lower power because Skill Haste/crit RES lines add little displayed power; matchmaking and the displayed power understate arena-geared teams.

posts.title_en: Anything to change in my Arena pets?
posts.summary_en: 13.69M pre-Bari five-ranged deck (Wind Archer, Brightseeker, Donut, Cheesecake, Milk, Ion, Macaron, Rye, Pinot, Pomegranate, Hound, Crepe) with Hot Doggie, Holy Baby Drop, King Choco Drop. Advice: the Rapid Fire pet is good, try swapping it with Choco Drop; perks Passion Pay + DR; Passion Pay's -20% HP hurts in Arena so General Perks (+1% all) or HP 5% work; Rapid Promotion is poor in Arena because Milk warms up slowly.
mechanics: Passion Pay's -20% max HP is felt in Arena.
Rapid Promotion (+7% ATK to top-ATK ally) is weak in Arena: Milk warms up slowly.

quotes.kr: 아레나는 체력 20퍼 까이는게 은근 체감 커서 올2퍼나 체력 5퍼 끼면 될듯
quotes.en: Losing 20% HP is noticeable in Arena, so take the all-stat perk or HP 5%.

posts.title_en: Arena: DR 10 vs Passion Pay / Promotion
posts.summary_en: Answer: runs Ion, Crepe, Hound as three tanks with Armor Repair (DR 10), plus Passion Pay.
mechanics: Armor Repair requires 3+ tank-type cookies.

posts.title_en: Which Arena perks?
posts.summary_en: Options given: Passion Pay + DR 10% or Passion Pay + Rapid Promotion. One keeps DR 10% even in stages because of Arena (merc perks apply to both).
mechanics: Merc perks apply to defense too (72627 title asks; 76808 implies perks are account-wide, not per mode).

posts.title_en: Which Arena pets?
posts.summary_en: Holy Baby Drop, King Choco Drop, Hot Doggie, Icy Birdie are the usual picks.

results.usage: 갓방울, 초코왕방울, 핫도그, 얼음새 most used

quotes.en: Usually Holy Baby Drop, King Choco Drop, Hot Doggie, Icy Birdie.

posts.title_en: Any good Arena deck?
posts.summary_en: Pre-Bari: poster notes you lose when Milk runs forward to heal. Reply shares a 5-ranged 'spear' deck: Princess(?)/바궁 (Wind Archer), Macaron, Seeker, Rye, Donut, Milky Way, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Espresso, Milk, Hound; pets Holy Baby Drop, Hot Doggie, Icy Birdie (or King Choco); perks Passion Pay + All Ammo Provided (5 ranged). Pomegranate buff to Espresso and Wind Archer. Milk goes front; you win by killing their Milk first or polymorphing it.

teams.name: Five-ranged 'spear' deck (5사격 죽창덱), pre-Bari
teams.perks: 열정페이 + 탄약비 전액 지원 (All Ammo Provided)
teams.why: Kill or polymorph the enemy Milk before yours dies.

mechanics: Milk running forward to heal and dying loses the fight.

quotes.kr: 내 우유가 터지기 전에 상대 우유를 터트리거나 도넛빔으로 ㅄ 만들면 이겨서 괜찮음
quotes.en: You win if you pop their Milk or polymorph it with Donut before yours pops.

posts.title_en: Rye (호황) is insane
posts.summary_en: Early Rye one-carry wins across a 3-4M power gap: Rye 2.47M damage vs an opponent with Rye, Wind Archer, Milky Way, Crepe, Seeker. Poster's lineup included Ion Lv97, Macaron, Hound, Dark Choco, Pinot, Donut, Grapevine. 'Arena is Rye's best these days'; ATK rune on Rye for the straw.

counters.team: Multi-ranged deck (Rye, Wind Archer, Milky Way, Seeker)

quotes.en: Chews through a 3-4M gap.

posts.title_en: The Arena Oven deck is good
posts.summary_en: 6.14M Bari–Oven deck with Bari 1★ beats older decks at up to double power. Formation top: Macaron, Pinot Noir, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb; bottom: Oven Wanderer, Cheesecake, Bari, Hound, Cherry Cola, Moon Rabbit. Pets Holy Baby Drop 20, Hot Doggie 17, Icy Birdie 18. posts.title_en: Low-ranked players: leave your defense open
posts.summary_en: Deliberately weak defense (850K: five cookies incl. Lv.1s) while attacking with a 5.96M team; 16th overall at Elite Master 1 (2,405 points). A loss on defense costs at most -5, a revenge win gives back more; weaker players climbing past you become revenge targets. Top-3 on the server at 3,007/2,804/2,739.
mechanics: Losing a defense to a lower player costs up to -5 points; the attacker gains +15 to +25; hitting a higher player back via revenge gives more than the loss.
rules: Elite Master 1 → promotion condition 3,000 trophies and top 30 overall; promotion pays 4,000 diamonds.
Defense log has a 'revenge' (복수) button to attack whoever hit you.

posts.title_en: Our #1 says Oven is good (vs Cowardly boss) and in Arena
posts.summary_en: Server #1 put Oven Wanderer in his Arena deck to pull Espresso's skill away. Mostly about the Cowardly Cookie boss.
mechanics: Claim: Oven dives in and draws enemy skills such as Espresso's (aggro sponge).

posts.title_en: Perpetual #2: advice on my Arena deck
posts.summary_en: 8.3M five-ranged deck with Milky Way. Advice: Milky Way only belongs in a five-ranged deck; drop Herb and add Espresso; drop Milky Way for Oven, which draws Wind Archer's ultimate (nearest enemy) and Donut's polymorph (highest HP) if it has the most HP (claim); without merc level 4, Milky Way and Ion aren't worth it, Cheesecake and Crepe are better.
mechanics: Claim (low confidence): Wind Archer's ultimate targets the nearest enemy; Donut's polymorph targets the highest-HP enemy, so a high-HP Oven can soak both.
disagreements: Oven decoy theory is dismissed by another commenter as an 'Oven addict'.

posts.title_en: My unique Arena deck
posts.summary_en: 8.51M attack team with Lemon, Rye and Wind Archer as dealers (Lemon gets Pomegranate's beam via Projectile Speed synergy), Skating Queen, Milky Way, Pinot, Pomegranate, Milk, Cheesecake, Donut, Macaron, Hound. Pets Holy Baby, Hot Doggie, Icy Birdie. Reply: Milky Way hogs Macaron.
mechanics: Pomegranate grants Projectile Speed synergy; Lemon (Projectile Speed) locks onto Pomegranate's beam.

posts.title_en: An Arena deck with no TSSR
posts.summary_en: 8.55M no-TSSR deck (Macaron, Donut, Cheesecake, Grapevine, Milk, Crepe / Rye, Pinot, Pomegranate, Espresso, Hound, Herb); pets Holy Baby 20, Icy Birdie 18, Chargemellow 16. 12-hour defense log is almost all wins against Wind Archer/Macaron/Seeker/Rye decks; normal win rate 50-60%; GM3 to Master 1. Rye and Espresso need 5★; Skill Haste 3.4 on six lines; ATK order Milk–Espresso–Macaron–Rye.

posts.title_en: Arena gear is always Skill AMP + Skill Haste?
posts.summary_en: Replies: crit DMG is good, crit rate less so, swap if the power gap is big; another says Arena is always 6 Skill Haste.
disagreements: Crit rate vs crit DMG again (see 76269, 75569).
